note.i: Passio Dei non videtur recte dici posse miraculum, quia causas habuit naturales in humana natura Christi: et tamen interim res summe admiranda est, quod Filius Dei passus est.

page.notes: Left margin: the first note is in italic and readable. The second note is damaged: "cactus" is doubtful, and the Greek words after "defendit:" are illegible, so the Greek is not transcribed. The Greek word in the text near "Pharisæorum" is not clear either. The word "Responde0" is printed as shown and may be a misprint for "Respondeo"; it was copied as printed. Several letters at the page edge are faint, but the body text is legible.
